org: Central Silk Board · CSTRI · RSTRS Dharmavaram
title: The Silk Testing Laboratory System
railSub: A visual guide for the Unit In-Charge
sub: A system that knows where every sample is, who tested it, on which balance, in what room conditions, against which version of which method — and can prove all of it four years later.
howto: Read it top to bottom in about twenty minutes, or jump straight to **Follow one lot** to see the whole thing working on a real consignment. The last section, **Over to you**, is the only part that needs anything from you. Nothing here is technical, and nothing here is decided without you.
facts: Shri Sanjeev Gupta, Scientist-D, Unit In-Charge
RSTRS / Silk Conditioning & Testing House, Dharmavaram
